title: Moorland Health — outbound pilot & security-first approach
content:
Notes to self: target = Moorland Health (regional hospital chain, 8 hospitals + 12 clinics). They run Epic/EHR integrations, heavy compliance (HIPAA), on-prem integrations for imaging, and have an internal ML/data team (4 people) but no production LLM infra. Key hypothesis: they'll respond to a security-first pilot offering Private deployment + KMS + audit logs + bounded latency SLOs for triage assistant use-case.

Quick account snapshot:
- Decision-makers: Dir. of Clinical Innovation (Alyssa Reed), CIO (Michael Bhandari), Head of Procurement (TBD).
- Pain: clinician burnout on triage notes, long discharge summary times, cost pressure.
- Constraints: cannot send PHI to third-party without BAAs + VPC/air-gapped options. SLA budgets: want predictable costs — node-based pricing preferred.

Value props to test in outreach:
1) Private deployment option: VPC/on-prem package with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
2) Predictable capacity: Redwood Dedicated reserved pools to guarantee throughput during shift-change spikes.
3) Quality regressions guarded: evals tied to small prompt set (discharge/triage) + rollouts with canary + automatic fallback if hallucination risk spikes.
4) Cost controls: batching/caching suggestions and per-token breakdown in Console for audit.

Outbound sequence (short):
- Email 1 (intro): brief, call out HIPAA + on-prem option, offer 30-min pilot design workshop.
- LinkedIn + follow-up 3 days.
- Email 2 (case study): anonymized regional hospital that cut triage note time by ~28% in pilot (mock stat — test with AE to validate).
- Call script: focus 10-min discovery around data residency, EHR integration, current triage workflow.

Draft email (keep short):
Subject: Reducing triage note load at Moorland Health — secure pilot?
Hi Alyssa — I work with Redwood Inference, we help hospital teams run LLM features with private deployments and audit-grade controls (KMS, VPC, on-prem option). Would you be open to a 30-min call to map a low-risk pilot to reduce triage note time by ~20–30%? I can bring an engineer to touch on integration points (Epic APIs) if useful.
Thanks,
Ethan

Anticipated objections + responses:
- "We can't send PHI to cloud": Response = we offer Private deployments with customer-managed keys + on-prem package; we can run initial pilot in their VPC or on-prem.
- "Budget is tight": Response = propose a 6–8 week fixed-scope pilot with capped reserved capacity; show estimated cost-per-discharge reduction and clinician-hours saved.
- "We need HIPAA BAA and SOC reports": Response = confirm BAA available; point to security docs and offer compliance review with our security team.
- "Concern about hallucinations / clinical risk": Response = outline eval plan + prompt guardrails + automatic fallback policy to simpler templates / human-in-the-loop for high-risk cases.

Pilot idea (6 weeks):
Week 0: Align success metrics + data scope (5–10 prompt templates for triage/discharge).
Week 1–2: Private deployment provisioned in their VPC + small integration to Epic test instance; baseline metrics.
Week 3: Internal QA + cal/thresholds for hallucination detection; staff training for clinical review.
Week 4–5: Live pilot with subset of clinicians (day shifts) + daily logs.
Week 6: Evaluate metrics (time saved, clinician satisfaction, error rates) + decision meeting for scale.

Open questions (to confirm before outreach):
- Who owns integrations for Epic (internal team name / contact)?
- Procurement cycle length and preferred contract start date?
- Are there existing vendor lists or GPO constraints?

Collateral to attach if they reply: one-pager (security + private deploy), short case study (anonymized), proposed SOW template for pilot, compliance pack (SOC/BAA).

Next steps for me this week:
- Sync with Lena (security) to validate compliance bullets and get the BAA PDF.
- Draft a one-pager tailored to Moorland with estimated cost model (tokens per discharge estimate).
- Find a credible regional hospital case example we can anonymize and use in Email 2.

Random thoughts / wishlist items:
- Could run a small internal eval on a public triage/discharge dataset to produce demo outputs.
- Create a short video (3 min) showing Private deployment UX + Console cost view for procurement teams.

Slack refs / tickets: see RED-1123 for permission checklist; add an internal note to #enterprise-sales with pilot ask.

Notes to self: be explicit about fallbacks (human review) in any clinical copy. Keep initial ask small (30 min).
